name: imf_compare_countries
description:
The same IMF indicator for two or more countries, one series each, from the IMF SDMX JSON data service (dataservices.imf.org, no API key).
Returns: database, indicator_code, frequency and countries: per country the series (database, country_code, indicator_code, frequency, data (period, value) and count; a note when the series is empty) or country_code and error.
Inputs (* required): country_codes* (array of at least 2 ISO 2-letter codes); database (IFS, DOT, BOP, GFSR, FSI, WEO, GFSMAB, CDIS, CPIS, WHDREO; default IFS); indicator (a WEO name when database is WEO, else an IFS name; see imf_get_weo_data and imf_get_ifs_data) or indicator_code (wins); one of the two is needed; start_year and end_year (1950-2030; omit both for the full history); frequency (A, Q or M; default A).
For one country use imf_get_data, imf_get_ifs_data or imf_get_weo_data.
Example: {"country_codes": ["US", "DE", "JP"], "database": "WEO", "indicator": "public_debt", "start_year": 2015, "end_year": 2025}

start_year.description: First year, YYYY; if only end_year is given this defaults to 1950

end_year.description: Last year, YYYY; if only start_year is given this defaults to the current year; omit both for the full history

frequency.description: Frequency: A annual, Q quarterly, M monthly

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Compare economic indicators across countries for benchmarking and analysis.
